title: Documenting Ethical Considerations in Open Source AI Models
findings: Religion was identified as one of several potential factors for biased output in AI model documentation, alongside gender, profession, and race. However, mentions of religious bias were found to be brief and lacked specific details, often just listing 'religion' as a potential bias factor without further explanation or examples.

measurement_description: Documentation of potential religious bias in AI models. The study analyzed model cards and README files to see if and how developers document bias related to religion.
